name: Thistle Cookeite
source: A total innocent who dwells in the manse at the edge of town.  She is accompanied by her butler and dwells in utter poverty.  She is constantly hungry and can be trusted to devour any food put before her.  Because of the extreme poverty she has experienced, she thinks it is normal to drink tea that has been diluted hundreds of times and eat the grass growing in the garden. [spoiler] She is actually a former priestess from the neighboring nation, who escaped the country some time after the war.  Her bloodline is considered to be of great value to her homeland, as it is tied up with their religious beliefs. [/spoiler]
